title: Hardware Key Proxy Terraform module + secrets-operator sidecar for HSM-backed rotations
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Deliver a reusable Terraform module that provides a cross-cloud "hardware-key-proxy" and an opinionated secrets-operator sidecar pattern for syncing and rotating secrets against HSM-backed key stores (cloud KMS + on-prem HSMs + Vault transit).

Motivation: Current private deployments require bespoke glue code to integrate Vault/Secrets Manager with customer HSMs and to perform safe rotations. We need a standardized, auditable IaC module that:
- exposes a minimal, consistent interface for platform teams to wire KMS/HSM endpoints into Redwood Private;
- provides lifecycle hooks for key sync, rotation scheduling, and post-rotation health checks;
- includes an operator-friendly sidecar pattern (stateless syncer) for workloads that require short-lived secrets and certs;
- enables attestation checks and drift detection so SREs get early warnings when keys fail HSM handshakes.

Scope / Acceptance criteria:
1) Terraform module features:
   - resources to provision a modular hardware-key-proxy (load-balanced set of EC2/GCE instances or k8s deployment) and required network constructs (VPC endpoints, route policies).
   - outputs and variables designed for cross-cloud compatibility (GCP/AWS/On-prem) and for both cloud KMS and Vault transit backends.
   - optional modules to wire into existing Vault clusters (mount points, policies) or into Secrets Manager connector configurations.
   - IAM/KMS policy templates and HSM attestation config snippets (documented).
2) Secrets-operator sidecar pattern:
   - lightweight container that subscribes to Secret metadata and performs: fetch, decrypt (via hardware-key-proxy), write to in-memory volume, and health-check post-rotation.
   - sidecar exposes /health and /metrics and supports readiness checks tied to HSM handshake status.
3) Rotation and health checks:
   - built-in Terraform cron invocation stub for rotation orchestration and a recommended canary rollout plan for key rotations.
   - a lambda/k8s job-based health probe that validates key unwrap/sign operations against HSM and records status to Redwood Console metrics endpoint.
   - drift detection: terraform-managed sentinel rule (or equivalent) to alert when external key material changes.
4) Testing and validation:
   - unit tests for Terraform using kitchen-terraform or terratest examples.
   - integration runbook showing how to bootstrap against a Vault dev cluster and a mock HSM (SoftHSM) in CI.
   - e2e: deploy module into a private dev VPC, perform rotation, validate canary traffic handles both old and new keys for 5 minutes.
5) Documentation & playbooks:
   - example usage in private deployment template repos, migration guide for existing customers, security review checklist.

Non-goals:
- Bundling a specific HSM vendor SDK into the module (we provide well-documented extension points).
- Replacing customer-managed Vault clusters — only supply integration scaffolding.

Implementation notes / design trade-offs:
- We implement hardware-key-proxy as a thin certificate-authenticated proxy that translates Redwood's secrets operator calls into vendor-specific HSM operations. This minimizes changes to Vault/Secrets Manager configuration and centralizes attestation and metrics.
- To reduce blast radius, the rotation plan uses a staged rollout: service-level canaries -> traffic mirroring -> full shift. Terraform only provisions the orchestration primitives; the actual rollout is executed by the rotation controller job.
- For drift detection we will prefer cloud-native telemetry and Terraform state reconciliation over heavyweight polling. A lightweight probe running in the proxy will publish diffs when detected.

Security & compliance considerations:
- All paths must enforce TLS mTLS between operator, proxy, and HSM endpoints.
- Require KMS/HSM admin roles to be scoped to a rotation-service principal; provide audited audit-log sinks and an example KMS policy.
- Provide guidance for HSM-backed key lifecycle (retirement, rewrap, and secure deletion).

Deliverables:
- terraform/modules/hardware-key-proxy (module with examples for AWS, GCP, and on-prem reference).
- terraform/modules/secrets-operator-sidecar (k8s manifests, Helm chart example).
- ci/integration/soft-hsm-test-suite and terratest scenarios.
- docs/private/hsm-integration.md and runbook for rotations.

Risks & mitigation:
- HSM vendor behavior varies: mitigate by keeping vendor-specific code outside core module and documenting extension points.
- Complex networking in customer VPCs: provide a small network preflight checklist and a validation job to run pre-deploy.
- Rotation failure could impact customers: require staged canary & automated rollback hooks in the operator job.
